name: Fringed Looper
desc: Fringed Looper (Campaea perlata): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 3 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Campaea perlata, the pale beauty, also known as the fringed looper (caterpillar), is a species of moth in the family Geometridae, known as geometer moths, found in North America.
